mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CODE_TYPE) FROM ( SELECT CODE_TYPE FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE `LANGUAGE` = 'ko' AND USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY CODE_TYPE, `LANGUAGE`, USE_YN ) T
SELECT CODE_TYPE, COUNT(CODE_TYPE) AS CODE_TYPE_CNT FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE `LANGUAGE` = 'ko' AND USE_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY CODE_TYPE ORDER BY 1

SELECT CODE_TYPE, `LANGUAGE`, ID, LABEL, DETAIL, ORDERING, USE_YN, UP_ID, CODE_VALUE, EXTENSION_CODE, MAPPING_CODE FROM OP_COMMON_CODE
ORDER BY ORDERING
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OP_COMMON_CODE ( CODE_TYPE, `LANGUAGE`, ID, LABEL, DETAIL, ORDERING, USE_YN, UP_ID, CODE_VALUE, EXTENSION_CODE, MAPPING_CODE ) VALUES ( #{codeType}, #{language}, #{id}, #{label}, #{detail}, #{ordering}, #{useYn}, #{upId}, #{codeValue}, #{extentionCode}, #{mappingCode} )
mapper.update: UPDATE OP_COMMON_CODE SET CODE_TYPE = #{codeType}, `LANGUAGE` = #{language}, ID = #{id}, LABEL = #{label}, DETAIL = #{detail}, ORDERING = #{ordering}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UP_ID = #{upId}, CODE_VALUE = #{codeValue}, EXTENSION_CODE = #{extentionCode}, MAPPING_CODE = #{mappingCode} WHERE CODE_TYPE = #{whereCodeType} AND `LANGUAGE` = 'ko' AND ID = #{whereId}
mapper.select: SELECT CODE_TYPE , `LANGUAGE` , ID , LABEL , DETAIL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND CODE_TYPE = 'POP_ADMIN' AND DETAIL = #{detail} AND ID = #{id} AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d%H') BETWEEN CONCAT( (SELECT SUBSTRING(label, 1, 8) FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE='POP_ADMIN' AND ID = #{id} AND USE_YN = 'Y') , (SELECT SUBSTRING(label, 9, 2) FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE='POP_ADMIN' AND ID = #{id} AND USE_YN = 'Y') ) AND CONCAT( (SELECT SUBSTRING(label, 11, 8) FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE='POP_ADMIN' AND ID = #{id} AND USE_YN = 'Y') , (SELECT SUBSTRING(label, 19, 2) FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE='POP_ADMIN' AND ID = #{id} AND USE_YN = 'Y') )
